description: TileLang GEMV example splitk_gemv_vectorized (N = K = 1024, BLOCK_N = 2, reduce_threads = 32): C = B @ A over an f16 matrix B [N, K] and vector A [K] with f32 accumulation, a 2 x 32 thread block: thread (n, k) loads 8 f16 of row n per 256-element K step as one 128-bit vector, the 32 partial sums combined by atomic adds to a shared f32 accumulator; one CTA of 2 x 32 threads, the block-0 one, computing C's first 2 elements; compiled by extraction/tilelang_kernels.py
